summary: Indian equities traded mixed as IT sector weakness and Tata stock declines pulled the Sensex lower while Nifty stayed resilient. Global markets faced pressure from rising US Treasury yields and rate hike fears, extending India's weekly losing streak to six weeks. Individual stocks like Paytm and major banking names stayed in focus due to FCNR(B) profit reports.
